# Set up environment
```{r}
library(qqman)
library(circilize)
library(VennDiagram)
```

# SNP-GWAS
```{r}
data <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/SNPGWAS_Fasttree_LMM.txt", sep = "\t", header=T)

# Extract "BP" from the first column by splitting at "_"
positions <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(data[[1]]), "_"), function(x) x[2])

# Extract p-value from the 4th column
pvals <- data[[4]]

# Calculate -log10(p)
logp <- -log10(pvals)

# Construct final data frame
out_df <- data.frame(
  CHR = 1,
  SNP = ".",
  BP = as.numeric(positions),
  minLOG10P = logp,
  log10p = logp,
  r2 = 0
)

# Add header
header <- c("CHR", "SNP", "BP", "minLOG10(P)", "log10(p)", "r^2")
colnames(out_df) <- header

manhattan(
  out_df,
  chr = "CHR",
  bp = "BP",
  p = "minLOG10(P)",  # Use the column with -log10(p-values)
  snp = "SNP",
  main = "Manhattan Plot of SNP-GWAS\n Population Structure Controlled w/: FastTree (LMM)",
  col = c("skyblue", "orange"),  # Customize colors as desired
  genomewideline = -log10(5e-8),  # Set a genome-wide significance line if desired
  suggestiveline = -log10(1e-5)   # Set a suggestive significance line if needed
)
```


# SNP-GWAS
```{r}
data_DBGWAS <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/DBGWAS_Fasttree_LMM.txt", sep = "\t", header=T)
data_DBGWAS_annotations <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/DBGWAS_Fasttree_LMM_annotation.txt", sep = "\t", header=F)
colnames(data_DBGWAS_annotations) <- colnames(data_DBGWAS)
data_DBGWAS_annotations_v2 <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/DBGWAS_Fasttree_LMM_annotation_v2.txt", sep = "\t", header=F)
colnames(data_DBGWAS_annotations_v2) <- colnames(data_DBGWAS)

# Extract "BP" from the first column by splitting at "_"
positions_DBGWAS <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(data_DBGWAS[[1]]), "_"), function(x) x[2])

# Extract p-value from the 4th column
pvals_DBGWAS <- data_DBGWAS[[4]]

# Calculate -log10(p)
logp_DBGWAS <- -log10(pvals_DBGWAS)

# Get significance threshold
p_threshold <- 0.05/nrow(data_DBGWAS)


# Construct final data frame
out_df <- data.frame(
  CHR = 1,
  SNP = ".",
  BP = as.numeric(positions),
  minLOG10P = logp,
  log10p = logp,
  r2 = 0
)

# Add header
header <- c("CHR", "SNP", "BP", "minLOG10(P)", "log10(p)", "r^2")
colnames(out_df) <- header

manhattan(
  out_df,
  chr = "CHR",
  bp = "BP",
  p = "minLOG10(P)",  # Use the column with -log10(p-values)
  snp = "SNP",
  main = "Manhattan Plot of SNP-GWAS\n Population Structure Controlled w/: FastTree (LMM)",
  col = c("skyblue", "orange"),  # Customize colors as desired
  genomewideline = -log10(5e-8),  # Set a genome-wide significance line if desired
  suggestiveline = -log10(1e-5)   # Set a suggestive significance line if needed
)
```

```{r}
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_CDC")
cl_eggnogg <- read.delim("panaroo_annotation.txt", sep = "\t", header=F, comment.char = "#")
web_eggnogg <- read.delim("web_panaroo_annotations.txt", sep = "\t", header=F, comment.char = "#")

cl_eggnogg |> filter(! V1 %in% web_eggnogg$V1)
web_eggnogg |> filter(! V1 %in% cl_eggnogg$V1)

web_eggnogg |> filter(V1  cl_eggnogg$V1)

test<- left_join(cl_eggnogg |> select(V1, V7, V8) |> rename("gene"="V1", "cl_COG"="V7", "cl_class"="V8"), 
          web_eggnogg |> select(V1, V7, V8) |> rename("gene"="V1", "web_COG"="V7", "web_class"="V8"))
test  |> 
  select(gene, cl_COG, web_COG)|> 
  filter(cl_COG != web_COG)

test  |> 
  mutate(cl_COG = ifelse(cl_COG =="-", "S", cl_COG))|> 
  mutate(web_COG = ifelse(web_COG =="-", "S", web_COG))|> 
  filter(cl_COG != web_COG)

web_eggnogg$V8 != cl_eggnogg$V8

nrow(cl_eggnogg)
nrow(web_eggnogg)+267
```
